articles.title: Netanyahu denies Israel is to blame for conditions in Gaza camps, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is disputing claims that Israel is blocking winter supplies to Gaza as severe rains have flooded makeshift tents in the enclave. Instead he blamed Hamas on Wednesday, and also accused them of seizing aid for military use. Meanwhile, Iran reports a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. In Gaza, Israeli strikes killed three people. And in Egypt, a judge in Cairo has postponed the retrial of the editor-in-chief of Mada Masr, one of Egypt’s last independent news outlets, for a week.
